content:
Orange Pi O1 is a new single board computer (SBC) based on the somewhat older SOPHGO BM1688 octa-core Cortex-A53 SoC with a built-in 16 TOPS AI accelerator/TPU, and support for decoding up to sixteen 1080p30 video streams, or encoding ten. The board comes with 8GB or 16GB memory, supports M.2 NVMe, eMMC module, SPI flash, SATA III, or microSD card storage, and offers HDMI and MIPI DSI display interfaces, two MIPI CSI camera connectors, dual GbE, WiFi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, and optional 4G/5G cellular connectivity,  as well as a few USB ports, audio interfaces, and a 26-pin GPIO header for expansion. Orange Pi O1 specifications: SoC – SOPHGO BM1688 CPU 8-core Arm Cortex-A53 processor @ 1.65 GHz RISC-V C906 co-processor @ 1.2 GHz TPU – SOPHGO Neural Network Acceleration Engine (TPU), delivering 16 TOPS @ INT8 VPU Video decoding – H.264 & H.265 up to 16 channels at 1080p30 Video [...]
